Software Engineer, Cloud Infrastructure
(Illustrative job description written for these tests. Not a real listing.)

About the job
Our infrastructure team builds the distributed systems that run cloud services for millions of customers.
You will design, build and operate large-scale backend services, improve reliability and latency, and
take part in design reviews and on-call.

Minimum qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or similar experience.
- 2 years of experience writing software in Go, Java, C++ or Python.
- 2 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.
- Experience with distributed systems and system design.

Preferred qualifications:
- Experience with Kubernetes, containers and cloud infrastructure on Google Cloud (GCP).
- Experience with gRPC or REST APIs, Kafka and PostgreSQL.
- Experience with observability, SRE practices and performance tuning.
- Experience with machine learning infrastructure.

Responsibilities
- Build and test backend services that other teams depend on.
- Lead design reviews and weigh the trade-offs between technologies with your peers.
- Give thoughtful code review and raise the bar for the codebase.
- Find the root cause of production issues and fix them for good.
